blocks.title: Sin demasiado 'yo' y 'nosotros'
blocks.text: En los informes en español es normal hemos analizado o se ha analizado. En inglés formal se prefiere la pasiva o un sujeto impersonal: The survey showed that ..., It was found that ..., y frases más cortas que en español.

head: Función
Formulación
Español
rows: With reference to your letter of 3 May, ...
En relación con su carta del 3 de mayo, ...
We would appreciate it if you could ...
We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
We regret to inform you that ...
Please do not hesitate to contact me.
No dude en ponerse en contacto conmigo.

blocks.title: Please find attached
blocks.text: Una fórmula fija: Please find attached the invoice o I attach the invoice (le adjunto la factura). Evita el anticuado Attached please find. En el archivo adjunto = attached, no in the attachment. Y Sin otro particular, le saluda atentamente no se traduce: basta con Yours sincerely o Kind regards.

rows: In the attachment you find the invoice.
Referring to your letter, we want to say ...
With reference to your letter, we would like to inform you ...
We apologise for the inconvenience it gave.
We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
Please do not hesitate to contact me.
Formal: please, y sin formas cortas.
The company must comply to the rules.
The company must comply with the rules.
We are responsible of the damage.
We are liable for the damage.

blocks.text: Completa con la palabra que falta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: With ______ to your email of 12 March, ...
items.full: With reference to your email of 12 March, ...

items.q: Please find ______ a copy of the contract.
items.full: Please find attached a copy of the contract.

items.q: We ______ any inconvenience this may cause.
items.full: We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.

items.q: We ______ to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
items.full: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.

items.q: Please do not ______ to contact me.
items.full: Please do not hesitate to contact me.

items.q: The purpose of this report is to ______ the results of the survey.
items.full: The purpose of this report is to present the results of the survey.

items.q: It is ______ that the company hire more staff.
items.full: It is recommended that the company hire more staff.

items.q: All products must comply ______ EU regulations.
items.full: All products must comply with EU regulations.
The offer is subject to availability.

items.q: The company is not ______ for any loss or damage.
items.full: The company is not liable for any loss or damage.

items.a: We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

items.q: No dude en ponerse en contacto conmigo.
items.a: Please do not hesitate to contact me.

items.q: La oferta está sujeta a disponibilidad.
items.a: The offer is subject to availability.
